source_run: GC head ablation, not original RIM training history
query_selection: Reuse the previously frozen seed42 query subsets without resampling
rank_scope: Each model ranks the same recorded 32 candidates: forced target plus 31 mined non-targets; candidate index zero is not rank one
teacher_scores: Recorded teacher_scores.npy for the corresponding training epoch
student_scores: Mining-snapshot query inference replay with the corresponding saved gallery embeddings
score_ties: Descending score; deterministic hash(seed, query_id, image_id) tie-break, independent of target role; tie sizes recorded
blinding: GPT sees only reference, instruction, anonymous A/B images and opaque case ID; no scores, rank, epoch, model identity, or target label
random_order: One fixed random A/B assignment per distinct unordered pair
same_image: Skip identical image ID or identical RGB pixels/dimensions; do not assume either satisfies instruction
repeated_unordered_pairs: Reuse one GPT judgment and map the image-side labels to each model at each rank
